title: Spinning bulk-to-boundary correlators in the massless theories with Poincaré symmetry
summary: We classify the bulk-to-boundary correlators for general integer-spin $s$ operators in a Poincaré-invariant theory by imposing suitable fall-off conditions near future/past null infinity. Any bulk-to-boundary correlator is a linear superposition of a set of basic tensor structures fixed by the little group \text{ISO}(2) of massless particles. We map the independent tensor structures to all possible non-crossing double-line diagrams.
